}}'''Dimana Corrand''' is part of the [[Knitting Circle]] inside the [[Kin]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Dimana Corrand}}

== Appearance ==
She has white streaking her bright red hair. Although her true age is 323 she appears to be well into or just past her middle years, on the edge of being called old.

== History ==
She was born in {{ne|677}} and grew up in a village in the [[Black Hills]] which she sometimes joked was as isolated as the legendary [[Seleisin]]. She went to the Tower in {{ne|694}} were she remained as [[Novice]] for three years. After she was put out of the White Tower for lacking sufficient strength.

Before leaving Ebou Dar, Dimana was a prosperous seamstress, with a number of seamstresses working for her, catering to the wealthier merchants and mid-rank nobles of the city.

== Strength ==
Her strength in the power is {{opsl|52}}, a very low one, just one level below the minimum to be tested for Aes Sedai.
== Activities ==
She [[Traveling|Travels]] with the the rest of the group led by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Elayne Trakand]] from Ebou Dar to the Kin's [[farm]] with the [[Bowl of the Winds]].

Dimana now resides in [[Caemlyn]] and is helping former ''[[damane]]'' be reintegrated into society. She has [[Marille]] with her when [[Gawyn Trakand]] questions Marille on what a [[Bloodknife]] is. Dimana then brings [[Kaisea]] to Gawyn for further questioning.
